newsitem.title: CANADA: Great Lakes buys hydro-electric firm.
newsitem.headline: Great Lakes buys hydro-electric firm.

text.p: Brascan Ltd said on Tuesday that it has added to its power operations with the purchase of Hydro-Pontiac Inc at a cost of C$118 million.

The acquisition of Hydro-Pontiac, an independent power company operating two hydro-electric generating stations and related transmission lines in eastern Canada, was made through Great Lakes Power Inc, Brascan's 93-percent-owned subsidiary, Brascan said.
Edward Kress, executive vice-president of Brascan and president of Great Lakes Power, said the move was "an important step" in diversifying Brascan's power operations.
The purchase will be settled by Great Lakes paying C$30 million in cash, issuing 554,455 common shares and assuming C$74 million of project financing, Brascan said.
